sources.title: Interagency Policy Statement on Allowances for Credit Losses
sources.review_scope: Historical information, forecasts, reversion and documentation sections examined; banking agency guidance, not acquired ASC text.

sources.title: Current Expected Credit Losses (CECL)
sources.review_scope: Official search discovery only. Direct page retrieval on 2026-10-04 returned 403; current page body not verified. Substantive CECL explanation instead uses the directly examined Federal Reserve interagency policy. No alternate access route attempted.

sources.title: Bank Accounting Advisory Series — August 2026
sources.review_scope: Observed August 2026 edition (244 PDF pages), foreword and selected sections 2D, 5A and 7A examined. Foreword states March 31, 2026 issue-observation cutoff. Staff interpretations, not OCC rules or regulations. Source body and publisher quotations not included.

sources.title: Governmental Reporting Overview — Modified Accrual Basis of Accounting
sources.review_scope: Measurement-focus, capital-asset and depreciation discussion examined. Local 60-day convention and consumption-method policy are not treated as universal GASB rules. Current undated page observed; no comprehensive standard verification.

sources.title: Agencies that issue Stand-Alone or Audited AFRs
sources.review_scope: Basic Financial Statements subsections examined for government-wide/fund scope and reconciliation. Page contains other updated reporting guidance outside this article scope.

sources.title: Governmental Funds — Fund Balance Classifications
sources.review_scope: Classification and encumbrance sections examined. Texas account numbers, specific state decision makers and sample entries are not copied into original scenarios.

sources.title: Leases — Recognition and Measurement for Lessees
sources.review_scope: Governmental and business-type activity presentation examined. State account codes, source numerical examples and embedded publisher Q&A are not reproduced.

sources.title: Subscription-Based IT Arrangements — Stages of Implementation
sources.review_scope: Agency-authored stage and training discussion examined. Embedded GASB Q&A excluded from reuse and not used as the original example pattern.

sources.title: Louisiana Governmental Audit Guide — 500-1040 Report Types
sources.publisher: Louisiana Legislative Auditor / Society of Louisiana CPAs
sources.review_scope: Report-type, outside-party and independence discussion examined. Jointly authored state guide; no blanket public-domain claim. State thresholds and combined review/attestation category are not generalized.

sources.title: Financial Audit Manual, Volume 1 — June 2025
sources.review_scope: GAO-25-107705, published June 12, 2025, 510 PDF pages; selected audit methodology, sections 475, 480 and 495 A examined. Federal methodology with AU-C references, not complete current AICPA standards. Publisher text and illustrative report forms are not reproduced.
